$comment: Message, read from Google's discovery document: id, threadId, labelIds. Gmail returns the stored message rather than an envelope, so the response is the object itself.

values.$comment: Drawn once. A message sent into a NEW conversation has id === threadId -- Gmail starts the thread with the message that opened it -- and two independent draws would produce a shape Gmail never sends for a first send.

response.$labelComment: SENT only. A faker that also claimed INBOX would describe a message to yourself, which is the one case where Gmail adds it -- and an author branching on labels would build against the exception rather than the rule.
